name: Signal Cluster S11: Calendar Detection Full Coverage
description: Exercises: is_period_boundary (month/quarter/week/year × start/end × ordinal combos), day_of_week, month_of_year, quarter, week_of_month, turn_of_month, valuewhen, falling, is_null, bar_gap
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER: Full Calendar + Missing Base Transforms Coverage
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === is_period_boundary: all period types ===
month_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())
month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(index())
quarter_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.quarter)(index())
week_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())
year_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.year)(index())

# === is_period_boundary: ordinal + day_anchor combos ===
first_monday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.first, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.monday)(index())
last_friday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.last, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.friday)(index())
second_tuesday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.second, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.tuesday)(index())
fourth_thursday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.fourth, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.thursday)(index())
fourth_wednesday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.fourth, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.wednesday)(index())

# === Calendar effect transforms ===
is_friday = day_of_week(DayOfWeek.Friday)
is_november = month_of_year(Month.November)
is_q1 = quarter(Quarter.Q1)
fourth_week = week_of_month(WeekOfMonth.Fourth)
tom_window = turn_of_month(days_before=2, days_after=3)()

# === Missing base transforms ===
falling_3 = falling(close, length=3)
null_check = is_null(rets)
entry_price = valuewhen(crossover(close, sma(close, 200)), close, occurrence=0)
bg = bar_gap(fill_percent=100)(o=src.o, h=src.h, l=src.l, c=src.c)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Month Start'
    )
)(close, month_start)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='First Monday'
    )
)(close, first_monday)

xy_lines(
    title='Entry Price (valuewhen)',
    category='Signal',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Entry Price', color=Color.Yellow)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=entry_price)
